notes.title: Happy Chinese New Year! Analysis of the special activities in the Gathering in C
notes.content:
The Spring Festival is here, and joy and happiness are all around!
In this beautiful moment of bidding farewell to the old and welcoming the new, the Chinese Heroes Operation Team extends the most sincere blessings to all players in advance. I hope that in the new year, we can work together with all the heroes of the national server to create our own Chinese Heroes world!
Well, the Spring Festival is here! Supporting activities are also indispensable! Today, I will introduce to you how to participate in the event and the props rewards that can be obtained!
Portal：http://hero.syinc.cn/Newzhyx/Zhxn25.html
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247758/3f5bedd778a181a0a9789c49255158f484086e93.jpg[/img]

[b]1. Welcome the Spring! Surprise holiday benefits are constantly being given[/b]
I always hear people say that we don’t give enough weekend benefits. “Not enough props!” “Give me more!”
Here it comes, it’s here!

The New Year CDK is coming! This Spring Festival, the main focus is to help your account move forward!

[b]CDK can be collected and the corresponding rewards:[/b]
New Year CDK: January 28, 2025 16:00-February 7, 2025 23:59
CDK Reward: Blessing Enhancement Scroll ( =Bound)*5, Thousand Miles Voice (Bound)*10, Fate Gift (Bound)*5, Backpack Expansion Scroll (III)*1, New Year Emoticon Pack*1

Lantern Festival: February 12, 2025 16:00-February 14, 2025 23:59
CDK Rewards: Whetstone*10, Thousand Miles Voice (Bound)*10, Fate Gift (Bound)*5, Backpack Expansion Scroll (III)*1, Heroes of Invincibility Pill*2

[b]Notes:[/b]
1. The relevant CDK needs to be collected within a limited time. CDK cannot be exchanged after the event ends

3. The reward props are not tradable
4. The final right of interpretation of this event belongs to the official Chinese Hero OL
5. The reward range of this event is only on steam/pc national server

[b]2. Send your own New Year's greetings! [/b]
New Year is here! The God of Wealth is here! Everyone will make their own New Year's wishes devoutly at the time of the New Year!
This year, Chinese Hero has prepared a special wishing sanctuary for everyone!
You can leave your New Year's greetings and personal wishes in this special area~

Note: Each person can only send 5 times at most. If the content is rejected 5 times, you will not be able to get rewards by participating in this event, so everyone must send blessings before sending!
